title: Softbody Jelly
description: A flower-shaped translucent soft body whose fixed-step neo-Hookean mechanics, view-dependent thickness, transmission, refractive shadow, and finite RGB caustics remain coupled while the specimen is dragged and released.
techniques: triangular-lattice tetrahedral cage with two-pass Loop optical shell
COM, rigid-spin, and internal viscous damping with sleep detection
dynamic BVH refraction with RGB absorption and bounded internal reflection
finite photon transport for receiver shadows, contact, and caustics
